description: For an AGENCY with GoHighLevel connected: send one SMS from its own GoHighLevel to one contact — by contact_id (from ghl_find_contacts), or by phone number (added as a contact if new). Read the exact message back to the agency and get its OK before calling: this sends a real message to a real person from the agency's own GoHighLevel and can't be unsent. Never message a contact marked Do Not Disturb, and only message people who have agreed to hear from the agency. One person per call; up to 100 messages a day.

message.description: The text, exactly as approved by the agency.

name.description: Their name, used only if a new contact has to be created.

phone.description: If there's no contact id: their mobile number.

name: ghl_send_sms
title: Text a contact from my GoHighLevel
